Pulling them under a compiler would either fail the typecheck or force them to be made valid, which would destroy what they test.

HYGIENE W3 G3 (DEVIATION, see the PR body). The dispatch scoped this root for deletion on the premise of zero references; docs/live-wire-measurements.md references measure.ts and payload-diff.ts three times as the re-runnable instrument that produced the merged before/after tables, so deleting it would strand a merged document — a §6 STOP. It also cannot be brought under a project as it stands: its imports (@prisma/client, socket.io-client, jsonwebtoken) live in packages/server/node_modules and pnpm's isolated layout gives a root-level project no way to resolve them, and the files carry pre-existing strict-mode errors. It is scanned instead by the phone-access-convention test's UNTYPECHECKED_ROOTS rule (packages/server/src/__tests__/phone-access-convention.test.ts). Owner: whoever next re-runs the live-wire measurement.
